test_title: PYST 20: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding direct speech.

She said that she had finished her work.

options.text: She said, "She have finished my work."
She said, "I have finished my work."
She said, "I am finished my work."
She said, "I was finishing my work."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she had finished her work.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she had finished" becomes "I have finished"**
 
 
• The Past Perfect tense (had finished) in indirect speech usually reverts to the Present Perfect tense (have finished) in direct speech when the reporting verb i
